title: Quinoa with Roasted Vegetables
subtitle: with tahini and date syrup
description: Fluffy quinoa topped with roasted onions and butternut squash, drizzled with raw tahini and silan, and finished with fresh herbs.

steps.text: Arrange the onions and squash on a tray lined with baking paper. Season with olive oil and salt and roast until golden, about 40 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring the water and salt to the boil in a medium pot. Add the quinoa and cook for about 20 minutes. Drain and transfer to a fairly flat serving bowl.
Arrange the roasted vegetables over the quinoa.
Drizzle with raw tahini and silan and scatter with the chopped herbs.
Add a little flaky sea salt and serve.
